en.name: Qwen Code
en.description: Qwen Code in Textus AI: Alibaba's Qwen models read your folder, write and edit your notes, and ask before they change anything.
en.setup: Needs Node.js 22 or later and an API key. Once, in a terminal: run npx @qwen-code/qwen-code, then /auth to set your key (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio or any OpenAI-compatible service).
